summary: A Latin and Caribbean groovebox built on GR!MM, adding a synthesized percussion source and style patterns from salsa and bomba to dembow and cumbia.
features: PERC source: 22 synthesized Latin percussion instruments across the keys
GROOVE plays 14 styles by itself, with parts, fills and swing
HUMAN knob loosens timing, level and pitch of each hit
ARP plays tumbao bass, montuno and guajeo lines over held chords
44 factory sounds and 10 kits; GR!MM's 4 tracks and 64-step sequencer
MIDI in and out, clock, autosave; doesn't read GR!MM saves

headings: the keys on a perc track
